title: StarterPlayer
summary: Holds per-player defaults and auto-run script containers: StarterPlayerScripts and StarterCharacterScripts run as LocalScripts for every player, plus default character/camera settings.

properties.name: StarterPlayerScripts
properties.description: Container whose LocalScripts run for each player (copied into PlayerScripts).

properties.name: StarterCharacterScripts
properties.description: Container whose LocalScripts are copied into each character model on spawn.

explanation.whatItIs: The 'what every player starts with' service: default movement/camera settings plus two magic folders that automatically run client code for every player.
explanation.whyItExists: You want one place that bootstraps each client (StarterPlayerScripts) and one place for per-character client logic (StarterCharacterScripts), without wiring it manually.
whenToUse: StarterPlayerScripts: your client bootstrap — input, UI manager, sound manager
StarterCharacterScripts: code that should restart with each character (character effects)
Tuning global defaults: walk speed, jump height, camera limits
whenNotToUse: Server logic — nothing here runs on the server
Code that must NOT re-run on respawn — use StarterPlayerScripts, not StarterCharacterScripts
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
StarterPlayer
 ├─ StarterPlayerScripts     → runs once per client session
 │    └─ ClientMain (LocalScript)
 ├─ StarterCharacterScripts  → runs once per CHARACTER spawn
 └─ (WalkSpeed, CameraMaxZoomDistance, … defaults)
```
tips: One ClientMain LocalScript that requires modules = clean client architecture
StarterCharacterScripts re-run every respawn — great for character-scoped effects
Character defaults can be overridden per-Humanoid at runtime
commonMistakes: Putting plain Scripts here expecting server execution — only LocalScripts run
Assuming StarterCharacterScripts state persists across deaths — it doesn't, they restart

examples.title: Client bootstrap pattern
examples.code:
-- StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ClientMain (LocalScript)
local Modules = script.Parent.Modules

local UIManager = require(Modules.UIManager)
local InputManager = require(Modules.Input)
local SoundManager = require(Modules.Sound)

UIManager.init()
InputManager.init()
SoundManager.init()

print("Client systems online")
